milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find ice spikes' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate toward and visually identify the ice spikes formation. Target [10, 4, 10] is the approximate centroid of the 5 packed_ice pillars at offsets (~8,~8), (~12,~5), (~6,~13), (~15,~12), (~10,~15). max_distance=8 was reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback: spawn-to-target distance is ~14.7 blocks, so max_distance=8 ensures the player must walk at least ~6.7 blocks toward the formation, preventing false triggering at spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the ice spikes, not just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because mining packed_ice with a Silk Touch tool yields a packed_ice item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with zero packed_ice (only a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe), so any packed_ice in inventory must have been mined from the ice spikes formation. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per guidelines. min_count=1 requires mining at least one block.
